title: Taylor secretly chief scientist of UAP Task Force

tellings.quote: unbeknownst to us, he gets called into meetings in Washington, D.C. and he's called in to be the chief scientist of the UAP Task Force.

plain: In 2020, a man named Travis Taylor was quietly called into meetings in Washington, D.C. and made chief scientist of the UAP Task Force, a Pentagon group set up to study UAP, the newer official term for UFOs. The owner of a ranch known as Skinwalker tells this to Michels, and says it happened "unbeknownst to us", meaning Taylor's colleagues at the ranch did not know at the time. If true, someone tied to the ranch was helping lead the government's own study of these objects.
